data.name: Reja
data.gender_notes: Reja is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'Rajaa', meaning 'to return', which refers to the moon's cycle of waning and waxing. The name Reja is also associated with the brightness and glowing nature of the moon. The name Reja carries the meaning “Moon, bright, glowing” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Reja usually hope their child will grow to embody moon, bright, glowing and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the cycle of life, renewal, and transformation.
data.etymology: Reja belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Moon, bright, glowing.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Reja total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: رضا
in_arabic.meaning: الرضا من الله الرحمن الرحيم القبول والرضوان من الله تعالى
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم رضا مشتق من الفعل رضي، وهو يعني القبول والرضوان من الله تعالى. يعتبر اسم رضا من الأسماء المحببة في الإسلام، حيث يرتبط بالرضا من الله والتوكل عليه. كما ورد في القرآن الكريم في سورة الأنفال آية 61: 'وَمَن يَرْضَ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ رَضِيٍ مِّنَ الأَشِيَاءِ ثَلاَثٍ'.

in_urdu.name: رضا
in_urdu.meaning: اللہ تعالیٰ کی رضا و خوشنودی کا مطلب ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: رضا کا نام عربی زبان سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے اللہ تعالیٰ کی رضا و خوشنودی۔ یہ نام اسلامی تقویم میں بہت مقبول ہے، کیونکہ یہ اللہ کی رضا اور توکل کا پرتیک ہے۔ جنوبی ایشیاء میں مسلمانوں کے ہاں یہ نام خاصی اہمیت رکھتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: रज़ा
in_hindi.meaning: ईश्वर की رضا और स्वीकृति का अर्थ है
in_hindi.long_meaning: रज़ा नाम की उत्पत्ति अरबी भाषा से हुई है, जिसका अर्थ है ईश्वर की رضा और स्वीकृति। यह नाम इस्लामी परंपरा में बहुत महत्व रखता है, क्योंकि यह ईश्वर की رضा और भक्ति का प्रतीक है। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में यह नाम विशेष रूप से महत्वपूर्ण है।

in_pashto.name: رضا
in_pashto.meaning: د الله رضا او منلو څرګندوي
in_pashto.long_meaning: رضا نوم د عربي ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې د الله رضا او منلو څرګندوي. دا نوم د افغان او پښتون قومونو په دودیزو کړو کې ډیر اهمیت لري، ځکه چې دا د الهي رضا او تسلیم نښه ده.

in_english.name: Reja
in_english.meaning: Means God's pleasure or approval in Arabic
in_english.long_meaning: The name Reja originates from the Arabic root 'R-Dh-Y', which means to be pleased or satisfied. In Islamic tradition, Reja signifies God's pleasure or approval. The name has been historically used across various Muslim cultures, symbolizing spiritual significance and divine favor. It is mentioned in the Quran in Surah Anfal, verse 61.

The moon's cycle of waning and waxing is an important concept in Islamic culture and is celebrated during various religious events such as Eid al-Fitr and Eid al-Adha. The name Reja can be seen as a reminder of the natural cycle of life and the importance of returning to one's faith and spirituality.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Reja holds immense spiritual significance as it can be seen as a reminder of the continuous cycle of seeking knowledge, patience, and faith in Allah. It is believed that through the ups and downs of life, just as the moon waxes and wanes, we too can return to our spiritual path with renewed conviction and determination. The name Reja can serve as an inspiration for individuals to seek spiritual growth and guidance, and to persevere through challenges with unwavering faith and hope.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The name Reja in Arabic means "rising" or "emerging." It symbolizes the idea of new beginnings, renewal, and growth. It is a reminder to always look forward, rise above challenges, and embrace the joy and potential of each new day.
